hero_note_one_text: Smoke, dust, and waste burning at street level — the sources that never reach a city monitor but decide what a neighbourhood actually breathes.
hero_note_two_text: Citizen photos, ground sensors, and satellite context fuse into a single confidence score, then reach the crews who can clear it the same day.
priority_sub: Delhi's air quality crisis plays out street by street, not city-wide. These are the three problems the platform is built to solve.
priority_one_text: Taking Delhi's air quality crisis into account is critical for the city's health and its future. VayuSetu puts hyper-local pollution intelligence in the hands of municipal teams for the first time.
priority_two_text: Air pollution harms human beings long before it shows up in a city average. Particulate matter from factories and stubble burning is a serious public health hazard — Sentinel-5P satellite data lets us see it from space.
priority_three_text: Ground-truth readings from CPCB stations anchor our model to real, calibrated air quality numbers. The forecast engine then gives neighbourhoods a head start before the next spike arrives.
ops_one_mode: Heightened alerting through the inversion season, with mist-cannon dispatch triggered on sustained PM2.5 breaches.
ops_two_mode: Satellite fire detections cross-checked against ground reports to separate crop residue from municipal waste burning.
ops_three_mode: Standing year-round programme covering demolition sites, haul routes, and uncovered material stockpiles.

program_sub: Science-based, AI-assisted tools for the communities that breathe the worst of it.
program_forecast_text: The forecast engine reads historical PM2.5 alongside OpenWeatherMap wind patterns to project air quality up to 24 hours ahead, so teams can pre-position cleanup crews instead of reacting to the peak.
program_forecast_alt: Illustration of a smog-covered Delhi skyline at sunset with commuters wearing face masks

cap_heading: From a photo on a phone to a crew on the street, with every step backed by evidence.
cap_copilot_text: Operators ask in plain language. Gemini calls live tools (open incidents, CPCB stations, wind, satellite fires, forecasts) and answers with the evidence it used.
cap_workorder_text: One click drafts an English and Hindi work order for the right agency, grounded only in the incident's recorded evidence.
cap_attribution_text: Live wind, known landfills and industrial areas, and NASA FIRMS fire detections point teams toward the likely source, including crop-residue fires across Punjab and Haryana.
cap_forecast_text: PM2.5 forecasts from live CPCB readings in BigQuery, a BigQuery ML ARIMA_PLUS model, and a Google Air Quality cross-check, each scored against what was actually measured.
cap_trust_text: Duplicate photos, screenshots, stale or far-away EXIF data, and per-device rate limits keep a single person from manufacturing a hotspot.
cap_loop_text: Every report gets a live tracking page, and WhatsApp reporters get a message when a crew is dispatched and when the hotspot is resolved.
